  • «And if you compare that to another content category, take animation series, kids family TV, it's also about 5% of our content spend, so the same amount of spend, but it's going to drive, we expect 8% of view hours.» [Netflix-Inc-_Earnings-Call_2026-07-16T00_00_00_English-1.pdf, pág. 5; documento de un tercero (transcripción); no depositado en la SEC]
